senses.gloss: pr. n. pl.Baalbek (En-Bekhi, later Heliopolis), an ancient city of Syria, renowned for its temples and bazaars (יריד).
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 11b:8">Ab. Zar. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>יריד שבעין ב׳</he> the bazaar at En B. (with its idolatrous rites).
<cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 5:8">Maasr. V, 8</cite> <he>שום ב׳ ב׳</he> Baalbek garlic.
